_readme: Manual stat labels. Key = '<PropertyType>.<field>' (see game.json -> statLabels). Fill 'en'/'ru' to replace the label shown on the site; 'format' may be 'percent' (value x100 %), 'multiplier' (x1.05 -> +5%), 'seconds', 'number' or 'hidden'. Empty strings mean 'use the game label / auto label'. This file is never overwritten by the extractor.
